reference.batch38-47.9fb80fbb28ce.ja: Rin.2/Rout.4、中心(.5,.5)、内壁接線速度.02、外壁静止、ν.01。N80/160/240、tau.7、T4、整数3840/15360/34560steps、両境界法計6runs。初期は解析場の平衡分布。

reference.batch38-47.5a9101e8b08e.en: Actual LBM cylinderRe20: Schäfer–Turek geometry anddeclared outlet
reference.batch38-47.5a9101e8b08e.ja: 実LBMのRe20円柱流：Schäfer–Turek形状と明示した流出境界

reference.batch38-47.a9337d9c9ccb.ja: [0,2.2]x[0,.41]、中心(.2,.2)、R.05、ν.001、rho1、平均流速.2/最大.3/Re20。dx.01/.005、x wet nodes221/441、y halfway nodes41/82、dt=dx/6、T30、18k/36ksteps。入口parabola、出口はrho1と隣接内点poststream速度による全9成分NEE。

reference.batch48-57.33bb46123eb0.en: Exterior series and scattering width of a dielectric cylinder
reference.batch48-57.33bb46123eb0.ja: 誘電体円柱の外部級数と散乱幅

reference.batch48-57.14abf7ac0f66.en: Lossless infinite cylinder, Ez polarization, c = epsilon0 = mu0 = 1, radius 0.25, epsilon = 2.25 and vacuum wavelength 1. The analytical field is exterior to the exact circle.
reference.batch48-57.14abf7ac0f66.ja: 無損失無限円柱、Ez偏光、c=ε0=μ0=1、半径0.25、ε=2.25、真空波長1。解析場は厳密な円の外部だけです。

reference.batch48-57.68dd7792b0ac.en: Independent ordinary cylindrical Bessel/Hankel boundary algebra and NIST Wronskian controls. Compare the analytical exterior field and total scattering width with actual finite-grid Yee fields. The extinction identity only checks the reference; it is not an additional measured FDTD observable. The exact circle differs from the declared staircase geometry. Retain the original coarse two-point collocation failure; a separate four-point diagnostic uses the unchanged 2% analytic-flux criterion.
reference.batch48-57.68dd7792b0ac.ja: 独立な普通Bessel/Hankel境界式とNIST Wronskianを用い、外部解析場と散乱幅を実Yee場と比較します。消散幅恒等式は参照の検査だけで、追加のFDTD測定ではありません。厳密円と明示した階段形状を区別します。旧2点補間の粗格子未達を保持し、別4点診断も解析流束の同じ2%基準を使います。

reference.batch48-57.eda0faf2b4ed.en: Complex oblique Fresnel coefficients and direct Lorentz-slab loss
reference.batch48-57.eda0faf2b4ed.ja: 斜め入射の複素Fresnel係数とLorentz板の直接散逸

reference.batch48-57.2d7a7a277671.en: Vacuum surroundings, ky = 4, slab [4, 5], epsilon_inf = 1.5, delta_epsilon = 0.75, omega_0 = 9, gamma = 0.5 and sigma = 0.04. Compare omega = 5.1/6/6.9 for both s = Ez and p = Hz.

reference.batch48-57.a85766cb5111.en: Independent continuum complex-root Fresnel slab algebra and direct volume dissipation, qualified for boundary continuity, passivity and quadrature. A separate closed finite-window vacuum geometric sum checks actual discrete monitor sampling. The analytical reference is frequency-domain r/t/R/T/A, not an exact transient Lorentz pulse field. Numerical vacuum propagation is explicitly removed; direct loss is not defined as 1-R-T.
reference.batch48-57.a85766cb5111.ja: 独立な連続複素根Fresnel式と直接体積散逸を、境界連続性・受動性・求積で資格確認します。別の有限窓真空幾何級数で離散monitor計測を検査します。解析参照は周波数領域r/t/R/T/Aであり、過渡場全体の厳密解ではありません。数値真空の伝播位相を除き、直接損失を1−R−Tで定義しません。

reference.batch48-57.03d4b1fe4ab3.en: Isolated same-grid reference for a long grazing dispersive packet
reference.batch48-57.03d4b1fe4ab3.ja: 浅角度分散波束の長時間・同格子孤立境界参照

reference.batch48-57.2614adeceaeb.en: The homogeneous Lorentz medium continues through the PML: epsilon_inf = 1, delta_epsilon = 0.2, omega_0 = 12, gamma = 0 or 0.005. An Ez-polarized finite-kx Gaussian has carrier omega = 6 and central phase angle 80 degrees. Joint grid/layer refinement uses peaks 6/9/12 on 512/768/1024 cells; the normal control uses 6 and damped fine companion 12. Final time is 700.
reference.batch48-57.2614adeceaeb.ja: 均質Lorentz媒質はPML内まで連続し、ε∞=1、Δε=0.2、ω0=12、γ=0または0.005。Ez偏光の有限kx Gaussianはcarrierω=6、中心位相角80度。512/768/1024点とpeak6/9/12を同時細分化し、垂直対照は6、弱減衰細格子対照は12。最終時刻は700です。

reference.batch48-57.c157d0fb716e.en: An independent 5 × 5 no-PML Fourier update matrix solves the constitutive block by LU instead of the primary scalar elimination, then propagates its eigenmodes. Compare periodic boxes of length 2048 and 4096 at every requested native point and time before cache use. The same discretization and initialization intentionally isolate boundary error from bulk dispersion; this is not an independent continuum time integrator. A separate continuum scalar root is only a carrier-dispersion diagnostic. Small operator checks and finite long trajectories are not a general dispersive-PML stability proof. The revised family changes grid and layer strength together; it is not a fixed-PML spatial-order test. The first fixed-peak experiment and its two unmet ratio gates remain retained.
reference.batch48-57.c157d0fb716e.ja: 独立な無PMLの5×5 Fourier更新行列は、主計算のスカラー消去とは別に物質blockをLUで解き、固有modeを進めます。全native点・時刻で長さ2048/4096のboxを比較してからcacheを使います。同離散化・初期場を共有して境界誤差を伝播分散から分離し、独立な連続時間積分器とは主張しません。別の連続スカラー根はcarrier分散の診断だけです。小作用素と有限の長時間軌道は一般安定性証明ではありません。 改訂族は格子と層強度の同時細分化で、固定PMLの空間次数検査ではありません。初回固定peak実験と未達の2比判定は保持します。

reference.batch48-57.af8a1a78ede1.en: Pivoted LU and Cholesky: exact-rational references for actual binary input
reference.batch48-57.af8a1a78ede1.ja: 部分ピボットLU/Cholesky：実二進入力の厳密有理数参照

reference.batch48-57.a58f5765db3c.en: The four fixed matrices use the actual binary64 A and b, converted exactly to Fractions. Rational elimination is exact, followed by a final binary64 rounding. Separate LAPACK comparisons share some numerical infrastructure. This is not a forward-accuracy guarantee for arbitrary ill-conditioned matrices.
reference.batch48-57.a58f5765db3c.ja: 固定4行列の実binary64 A,bをFractionへ厳密変換し、有理数消去の解を最後にbinary64へ変換。LAPACKは別比較であり共有数値基盤を含みます。任意の悪条件行列に対する前進精度保証ではありません。

reference.batch48-57.04789515eb0c.en: Symmetric saddles: independent dense solutions and the ideal-Schur spectrum
reference.batch48-57.04789515eb0c.ja: 対称不定値鞍点系：独立dense解と理想Schurスペクトル

reference.batch48-57.ded9e9faa446.en: Algebraic saddles A=[[H,B^T],[B,0]] use velocity sizes 12 and 24 and pressure sizes 5 and 11. Explicit dense SPD ideal-Schur controls compare the original residual separately with dense-solution error. This is not a Stokes boundary-value PDE.
reference.batch48-57.ded9e9faa446.ja: A=[[H,Bᵀ],[B,0]]、速度サイズ12/24、圧力行数5/11の代数問題。SPD理想Schurは全行列を小さく直接構成し、元の真残差とdense参照解誤差を別に判定。実Stokes境界値問題ではありません。

reference.batch48-57.809ea6ee41ac.en: Restarting and shift-invert: the closed spectrum of a fixed discrete matrix
reference.batch48-57.809ea6ee41ac.ja: 再始動/shift-invert：固定離散行列の閉スペクトル

reference.batch48-57.7d299a6eeb12.en: A fixed 31 x 31 Dirichlet tridiagonal matrix with h=1/32, restart lengths 8 and 16, and shifts none/0/950. The references are eigenvalues of this finite matrix, not a continuum PDE grid-convergence study.
reference.batch48-57.7d299a6eeb12.ja: 31×31 Dirichlet三重対角行列、h=1/32、再始動長8/16、shiftなし/0/950。参照はこの有限行列の固有値であり、格子細分化による連続PDE収束を認証しません。

reference.batch48-57.630d44076f67.en: Consistent-mass P1 string: closed discrete and continuum eigenvalues
reference.batch48-57.630d44076f67.ja: P1整合質量弦：閉離散固有値と連続体固有値

reference.batch48-57.b96b2361ccc2.en: Unit length, tension and density, homogeneous Dirichlet endpoints, 15/31/63 interior nodes, and the lowest three eigenpairs. Compare closed discrete eigenvalues with generalized dense LAPACK, then measure error relative to (j*pi)^2 separately. Displayed vectors are saved numerical modes with arbitrary sign.
reference.batch48-57.b96b2361ccc2.ja: 長さ・張力・密度1、両端Dirichlet0、内部15/31/63点、最低3固有対。閉離散固有値とgeneralized dense LAPACKを比較し、連続(jπ)²への誤差を別に調べます。表示ベクトルは保存した数値解で、符号は任意です。

reference.batch48-57.76031bb43b1a.en: Crossing the Bratu fold with pseudo-arclength continuation
reference.batch48-57.76031bb43b1a.ja: 擬似弧長継続でBratuのfoldを越える

reference.batch48-57.9f19079a6dd8.en: Same dimensionless1D Bratu on[0,1] with zero endpoints. The continuous family is evaluated independently in Decimal80;it is not an exact discrete root or Newton/GMRES trajectory.
reference.batch48-57.9f19079a6dd8.ja: 同じ無次元1次元Bratu、x∈[0,1]、両端u=0。連続解析族は独立Decimal80評価であり、離散解やNewton/GMRES反復の厳密解ではありません。

reference.batch48-57.32b0c230006e.en: Continuous analytic fields,family lambda/fold and original fixed ODE/endpoint qualifications. Neither the computed continuation path nor JFNK iteration trajectory is an analytic reference.
reference.batch48-57.32b0c230006e.ja: 連続解析形状・族のλ・foldと元から固定されたODE/端点資格。計算した継続曲線やJFNK反復軌道そのものは解析参照と呼びません。

reference.batch48-57.1d85549d73a3.en: Jacobian-free Newton–Krylov with analytic, central-FD and directional-AD products
reference.batch48-57.1d85549d73a3.ja: 解析・中央差分・方向ADによるJacobian不要Newton–Krylov

reference.batch58-67.9495aa7d78e5.en: Globalization from identical starts: analytic controls and discrete Bratu corrections
reference.batch58-67.9495aa7d78e5.ja: 同一初期値の大域化：解析対照と離散Bratu修正

reference.batch58-67.64f7e209b22a.en: Fixed real dimensionless systems: two Rosenbrock starts and two residual scalings, plus three starts for a 31-interior-node Dirichlet Bratu problem at lambda 3, compared by three methods. The Euclidean state radius is distinct from residual scaling.
reference.batch58-67.64f7e209b22a.ja: 実数・無次元の固定系。Rosenbrockの2初期値と2残差スケール、31内点・λ=3の同次Dirichlet Bratuの3初期値を3法で比較します。状態半径はEuclideanで、残差スケールとは別です。

reference.batch58-67.63ca331c7bf1.en: The primary reference is a numerical discrete correction. The known Rosenbrock root and rational/high-precision dogleg components are separate analytic controls; Bratu uses an independently assembled discrete Jacobian correction and original residual. No continuum family is an exact discrete root. Required-root rows, diagnostic starts, stationary nonroots and domain rejection remain distinct; no all-start guarantee.
reference.batch58-67.63ca331c7bf1.ja: 主参照は数値的な離散修正です。Rosenbrockの既知根と有理数・高精度dogleg部分参照は解析対照として分け、Bratuは別組立て離散Jacobianの修正で原残差を検査します。連続解析族を離散厳密解とはしません。必須成功行と診断行、非根停留・領域拒否を区別し、全初期値保証はしません。

reference.batch58-67.2ad6250fd97c.en: Independent Jacobians, JVPs and VJPs of discrete nonlinear maps
reference.batch58-67.2ad6250fd97c.ja: 離散非線形写像の独立Jacobian・JVP・VJP

reference.batch58-67.847c9c35bfa5.en: The fixed R4-to-R3 map includes repeated-index gather[0,0,2] and scalar broadcast. Wide maps and fixed Bratu states have sizes 7 and 31. Euclidean pullbacks and adjoints under specified SPD metrics are distinct.
reference.batch58-67.847c9c35bfa5.ja: 固定R4→R3写像は重複gather[0,0,2]とscalar broadcastを含みます。wide写像と固定Bratu状態はサイズ7/31。Euclidean pullbackと指定SPD計量の随伴を区別します。

reference.batch58-67.b8d0a8d8b99c.en: A hand-derived nonsymmetric rectangular Jacobian with separately evaluated high-precision exponentials is the reference. Independent stencil/transpose actions supplement it; symmetric Bratu alone cannot qualify transposition. These are analytic derivatives of finite discrete maps, not exact continuum PDE solutions or a general AD framework.
reference.batch58-67.b8d0a8d8b99c.ja: 手導出した非対称矩形Jacobianと、別のexp高精度評価を参照にします。線形stencil/transposeも別評価しますが、対称Bratuだけでは転置を資格しません。解析対象は有限離散写像の微分であり、連続PDEの厳密解や一般AD frameworkではありません。

reference.batch58-67.36af65130ee1.en: Independent references for fixed-state HVPs and second-order implicit rules
reference.batch58-67.36af65130ee1.ja: 固定状態HVPと二階陰関数則の独立参照

reference.batch58-67.866e25fc5815.en: Use a four-variable dyadic quadratic and fixed-state Bratu energies of sizes 7 and 31. A separate positive implicit branch u²-theta=0 is solved at theta 4 from initial u 3, distinguishing fixed-state partials from total derivatives.
reference.batch58-67.866e25fc5815.ja: 4変数のdyadic二次関数とサイズ7/31の固定Bratu energyを用います。別の正枝陰関数u²−θ=0はθ=4、初期値u=3から解き、状態固定偏微分と全微分を分けます。

reference.batch58-67.4206f20baf1c.en: References are rational Qv, an independently evaluated fixed-state Bratu stencil formula, and an oracle-only square-root family with rational values at theta 4. The primary solves F/R1/R2 without embedding that family. These are not continuum PDE solutions, general reduced inverse Hessians or derivatives of a finite Newton trace.
reference.batch58-67.4206f20baf1c.ja: 二次関数は有理数Qv、固定Bratu energyは別stencil式、陰関数はoracle専用sqrt族とθ=4の有理数値で照合します。primaryはF/R1/R2を解き、sqrt族を埋め込みません。連続PDE厳密解、一般のreduced inverse Hessian、有限Newton traceの感度とは扱いません。

reference.batch58-67.90b888460fb3.en: Nonsmooth discrete maps: directional derivatives and executed traces
reference.batch58-67.90b888460fb3.ja: 非滑らかな離散写像：一方向微分と実行trace

reference.batch58-67.6bc77cecc3f3.en: Use seven fixed points and directions ±1 for abs, ReLU, clip and a polynomial branch. The stopped iteration starts at x0 = 0, tests |xk - theta| <= 1/8 before updating and allows at mostfive updates. Theta 1/4, 1/2 and 1 are switching points.
reference.batch58-67.6bc77cecc3f3.ja: abs・ReLU・clip・多項式分岐の固定7点と方向±1を用います。停止反復はx0=0、更新前に|xk−θ|≤1/8を検査し最大5更新。θ=1/4,1/2,1は切替点です。

reference.batch58-67.ce9dd210f848.en: Rational piecewise formulas and the literal stopping rule provide references. Strict kinks retain undefined classical derivatives with null/validity, separately from directional maps and chosen-trace slopes. Finite quotients across a switch are not derivative limits, continuum PDE references or universal subgradients.
reference.batch58-67.ce9dd210f848.ja: 有理数の区分式とliteral停止規約が参照です。strict kinkでは古典微分を未定義としてnull/validityを保存し、一方向写像や選択traceの傾きと区別します。切替の有限差分商は微分極限ではなく、連続PDE参照でも普遍的subgradientでもありません。

reference.batch58-67.465f00c498f1.en: Backward-Euler discrete modes and time-exact semidiscrete diffusion references
reference.batch58-67.465f00c498f1.ja: 後退Euler離散モードと時間厳密半離散拡散の参照

reference.batch58-67.d75780cdd8ad.en: Dimensionless x in [0,1] with zero Dirichlet data, kappa = .1, theta = .2 and T = .1. Use 7/15 interior nodes and 64/128/256 time steps. The objective has an h-weighted terminal error and specified quadratic penalties.
reference.batch58-67.d75780cdd8ad.ja: 無次元x∈[0,1]、同次Dirichlet、κ=.1、θ=.2、T=.1。内点7/15、時間step64/128/256。目的関数はh重み付き終端誤差と指定二次正則化です。

reference.batch58-67.f9fb39d5ec45.en: Analytic references are scalar modal solutions and parameter derivatives of the same finite backward-Euler map. A separate time-exact semidiscrete exponential measures temporal error only and never substitutes continuum spatial eigenvalues. Checkpoint replay follows that same discrete reverse map; it is not CVODES or an optimal schedule. Qualification, primary execution and final packet evidence remain separate receipts.
reference.batch58-67.f9fb39d5ec45.ja: 解析参照は同じ空間差分の有限BE写像に対するscalar mode解とパラメータ微分です。時間厳密semidiscrete指数は時間誤差だけを測る別参照で、連続空間の固有値に置換しません。checkpointは同じ離散逆写像の再計算でありCVODESや最適scheduleではありません。資格・主計算・最終配布の実証は別レシートです。

reference.batch58-67.1f0a7acd4a20.en: Discrete Bratu shooting, tangent and adjoint references near a fold
reference.batch58-67.1f0a7acd4a20.ja: 離散fold近傍のBratu shooting・接線・随伴参照

reference.batch58-67.e31b02e1d05e.en: One-dimensional Dirichlet Bratu with 31/63 interior nodes. Fixed gaps .1/.01/.001 below the discrete-fold anchor use lower-branch states. Each lambda string is converted once to binary64 and that exact value is passed to the high-precision reference.
reference.batch58-67.e31b02e1d05e.ja: 1D同次Dirichlet Bratu、内点31/63。検証する離散fold anchorの下.1/.01/.001に固定し、下枝状態を用います。λ文字列は一度binary64へ変換し、その正確な値を高精度参照へ渡します。

reference.batch58-67.57d7ee4e3b43.en: Independent dense sensitivities and matrix-free VJPs for distributed Bratu coefficients
reference.batch58-67.57d7ee4e3b43.ja: 分布Bratu係数の独立dense感度と行列不要VJP

reference.batch58-67.6a829f6f5358.en: A one-dimensional zero-Dirichlet problem with 63 interior nodes. The coefficient a(x)=2+Btheta uses 8/16/32 linear-hat controls and stays between 1.7 and 2.3 in the fixed main cases. Endpoint coefficient controls are not zeroed like state Dirichlet values.
reference.batch58-67.6a829f6f5358.ja: 1D同次Dirichlet、63内点。a(x)=2+Bθは8/16/32個の線形hat制御で、主固定例は1.7≤a≤2.3。端点係数は零Dirichlet状態と異なり固定零にしません。

reference.batch58-67.2487bc30e7ea.en: A separately evaluated full dense-hat matrix and banded tangent solves for all controls form the numerical reference. They differ from the primary two-neighbor gather/scatter action but share the discrete forward model. This is not an independent exact continuum PDE solution or a claim of m-fold wall-time speedup. Coefficient-profile figures remain one-dimensional.
reference.batch58-67.2487bc30e7ea.ja: 別に評価した全dense hat行列と、全係数のbanded接線解を数値参照にします。primaryの2近傍gather/scatterとは別の作用で、同じ離散前進モデルです。独立な連続PDE厳密解やm倍のwall-time向上とはしません。係数分布図の空間次元は1です。

reference.batch58-67.6f81635cbebe.en: Independent Thomas-based local references for Bratu inverse least squares
reference.batch58-67.6f81635cbebe.ja: Bratu逆最小二乗の独立Thomas局所参照

reference.batch58-67.55d7bb8f946e.en: A two-coefficient inverse problem uses 31 interior nodes and five observations of the one-dimensional zero-Dirichlet Bratu model. Reuse existing synthetic data; the physical box is a in[1,2.8],b in[-.5,.5]. Objective regularization gamma, LM damping mu and variable scaling are distinct.
reference.batch58-67.55d7bb8f946e.ja: 1D零Dirichlet Bratuの31内点と5観測を用いる2係数逆問題。既存合成観測を再利用し、物理boxはa∈[1,2.8],b∈[-.5,.5]。目的正則化γ、LM減衰μ、変数尺度は別です。

reference.batch58-67.54098338d1e5.en: Use separate Thomas state/sensitivity evaluations and small local optimizer references. Some optimizer infrastructure is shared with a companion, so independence is not claimed at every layer. A common reference for unbounded GN/LM must be interior and unbounded-stationary. Bounded solutions, truth recovery and global minima are distinct; plotted a,b planes are coefficient space.
reference.batch58-67.54098338d1e5.ja: 別Thomas状態・感度と小さな局所最適化参照を用います。最適化libraryは一部companionと共有するため全層独立とはしません。非有界GN/LMの共通参照は内点かつ非有界停留であることが条件で、有界解・真値回復・大域最小を混同しません。図のa,b平面は係数空間です。

reference.batch58-67.286ccabbc64a.en: Analytic known minima and the current limited-memory action
reference.batch58-67.286ccabbc64a.ja: 既知最小点と現在の有限記憶作用に対する解析参照

reference.batch58-67.46347c98d2a5.en: Dimensionless unconstrained algebraic optimization uses an eight-dimensional SPD quadratic and three Rosenbrock starts. L-BFGS retains only the current last three pairs. There is no physical PDE boundary condition.
reference.batch58-67.46347c98d2a5.ja: 無次元・非有界の代数最適化。8次元SPD二次関数とRosenbrockの3初期値を用い、L-BFGSは現在の最大3組だけを保持します。物理PDE境界条件はありません。

reference.batch58-67.34ed99674f3b.en: Known analytic minima and gradients are references. L-BFGS actions are checked by a separate dense oracle initialized with the current gamma0 I and only the currently retained last three pairs in chronological order, distinct from all-history BFGS. The selected original weak-Wolfe discussion differs from the strong-Wolfe policy here; Fletcher 1970 full text remains unread. No exact n-step termination or general global-convergence guarantee.
reference.batch58-67.34ed99674f3b.ja: 既知の解析最小点・勾配を参照にし、L-BFGS作用は現在γ0Iと現在保持する3組だけを古い順に再生する別dense oracleへ照合します。全履歴BFGSとは別です。選択原著の弱Wolfeと本例のstrong Wolfeを区別し、Fletcher1970本文未読を保持します。厳密n-step終了や一般的大域収束は保証しません。

reference.batch58-67.7afaa8b9399a.en: Bratu references for finite gamma paths and local linear noise propagation
reference.batch58-67.7afaa8b9399a.ja: 有限γ経路と局所線形雑音伝播のBratu参照

reference.batch58-67.72458a9748ea.en: Independent small 2-by-2 linear-estimator formulas check fixed-gamma noise propagation and bias in a local Gauss–Newton linear model; nonlinear fits have separate Thomas/KKT audits. Evaluation at a selected gamma is not selection-conditional covariance, covariance including nonlinear residual Hessians, a posterior or a coverage guarantee. Selection requires all five fits qualified, never a successful subset. Ellipses are diagnostics in coefficient space.
reference.batch58-67.72458a9748ea.ja: 独立な小2×2線形推定式で固定γの局所Gauss–Newton線形モデルの雑音伝播とbiasを照合し、非線形fitは別Thomas参照とKKTで検査します。選択γで式を評価しても選択事象の条件付き共分散、非線形残差Hessian込み共分散、posterior、被覆率にはなりません。全5fitの資格前にsubsetからγを選ばず、図の楕円は係数平面の診断です。

reference.batch58-67.1aeb64a042d2.en: Use 31 interior nodes, five observations, W=I/5 and Sigma=sigma² I. Reuse existing 31/1023-grid observations. The noise standard deviations sigma are 1e-4 and 1e-3; two seeds provide independent base noises, while scaled/grid-context variants are paired. Gamma has five fixed values.
reference.batch58-67.1aeb64a042d2.ja: 31内点、5観測、W=I/5、Σ=σ²I。既存の31/1023格子観測を再利用します。雑音の標準偏差σは1e-4と1e-3で、独立な基底雑音は2 seedです。尺度・格子文脈をまたぐ比較は同じ雑音ベクトルを共有します。γは固定5点です。

reference.batch58-67.750d20cc9d35.en: The primary reference is independent high-precision discrete shooting/fold evaluation with zero-start Thomas Newton. The continuum cosh family is a separate shape/discretization diagnostic, not the exact discrete fold or state. Same-fixed-state residual identities are separate from state error and include the cross term for an approximate adjoint. Error/conditioning plot axes are not a two-dimensional physical domain. The displayed finite-reference identity retains both direct-reference residuals and does not assume the banded solves are exact.
reference.batch58-67.750d20cc9d35.ja: 主参照は独立な高精度離散shooting/foldと零初期Thomas Newtonです。連続cosh族は形状・離散化の別診断で、離散foldや離散状態の厳密値ではありません。同一固定状態の残差恒等式と状態誤差を分け、近似随伴にはcross項を含めます。図の誤差/条件数軸は物理2D空間ではありません。 表示する有限参照の恒等式では直接参照の両残差を保持し、帯行列の参照解が厳密であるとは仮定しません。

reference.batch58-67.5a133524e2cc.en: Real small systems with a fixed positive diagonal residual scaling; the trust radius uses the unscaled Euclidean state norm.
reference.batch58-67.5a133524e2cc.ja: 固定した正の対角残差スケーリングを持つ小さな実数系。trust radiusは変数のEuclideanノルムです。

reference.batch58-67.6abe61b8e7af.en: The Gauss–Newton endpoint is the minimum-norm SVD least-squares solution under the fixed rank cutoff; the other endpoint is the Cauchy step.
reference.batch58-67.6abe61b8e7af.ja: Gauss–Newton端点は固定rank cutoffの最小ノルムSVD最小二乗解、他端はCauchy stepです。

reference.batch58-67.b9f82d23eca6.en: Accept only a positive model decrease, positive actual decrease and rho >= .1; all radius/domain/model/iteration failures are explicit.
reference.batch58-67.b9f82d23eca6.ja: 正の予測減少・正の実減少とρ≥.1を要求し、半径/領域/model/反復上限の失敗を明示します。

reference.batch58-67.fc344283f309.en: Dimensionless fixtures; residual scaling is explicit and does not alter the original root tolerance.
reference.batch58-67.fc344283f309.ja: 無次元固定例。残差スケールを明示し、原残差の根判定は変えません。

reference.batch58-67.1c668c5d38d4.en: The method has no intrinsic physical boundary. Rosenbrock controls are algebraic; the related Bratu fixture has zero Dirichlet endpoints on[0,1].
reference.batch58-67.1c668c5d38d4.ja: 方法固有の物理境界はありません。Rosenbrockは代数系で、関連Bratu固定例は[0,1]両端零Dirichletです。

reference.batch58-67.d09da9c7d442.en: Maps only to this dedicated globalization-controls release; no execution is borrowed from existing Bratu continuation or JFNK.
reference.batch58-67.d09da9c7d442.ja: 今回の専用globalization-controls配布だけに対応し、既存Bratu継続やJFNKの実行を借用しません。

reference.batch58-67.f3cdf3774aac.en: Dogleg trust regions for fixed small systems
reference.batch58-67.f3cdf3774aac.ja: 小固定系のdogleg信頼領域法

reference.batch58-67.1d7775e5345b.en: Fixed small nonlinear systems separate the original residual from a left-scaled merit and check a Euclidean Cauchy–Gauss–Newton dogleg with every rejected trial retained.
reference.batch58-67.1d7775e5345b.ja: 固定した小非線形系で、原残差と左スケールmeritを分け、Euclidean Cauchy–Gauss–Newton doglegと全拒否試行を検証します。

reference.batch58-67.0a33aec24ab3.en: Only six required-root controls and declared diagnostic starts are covered. No exact optimal trust-region subproblem, all-start guarantee, PETSc implementation equivalence or large-scale performance is claimed.
reference.batch58-67.0a33aec24ab3.ja: 固定6必須rootと診断startの比較だけです。正確なTR部分問題解・全初期値成功・PETSc実装同等・大規模性能を保証しません。

reference.batch58-67.b2f36aeee025.en: Separately qualify larger sparse systems, other fixed radii/scales and broader nonlinear models with new inputs and references; no all-start convergence guarantee is claimed.
reference.batch58-67.b2f36aeee025.ja: より大きい疎系、別の固定半径・尺度、一般の非線形モデルは、入力と参照を別途固定して検証します。全初期値での収束を保証しません。

reference.batch58-67.b6db0ef3b5e7.en: Only the fixed root/product/implicit-scalar/piecewise maps in these releases; Bratu discretizations are separately related1Dmodel context. No general AD framework or universal nonsmooth derivative.
reference.batch58-67.b6db0ef3b5e7.ja: この配布版の固定した根・微分作用・陰関数スカラー・区分写像に限ります。Bratu離散化は別の1Dモデル文脈として関連づけ、一般的なADフレームワークや普遍的な非滑らか微分は主張しません。

reference.batch58-67.5d9ba1c64659.en: Finite-dimensional nonlinear maps, roots and differential actions
reference.batch58-67.5d9ba1c64659.ja: 有限次元非線形写像・根と微分作用

reference.batch58-67.612213a17089.en: Roots, JVP/VJP, HVP and branch conventions for finite algebraic maps. The variable count n is not a spatial dimension, and a classical derivative is not imposed at nonsmooth points.
reference.batch58-67.612213a17089.ja: 有限の代数写像に対する根・JVP/VJP・HVP・分岐規約です。nは空間次元ではなく変数数で、非滑らか点に古典微分を強制しません。

reference.batch58-67.01ca55cb5210.en: Fixed Rosenbrock/small-Bratu globalization, rectangular repeated-gather/broadcast maps, fixed-state HVPs, positive implicit rules and literal stopping conventions.
reference.batch58-67.01ca55cb5210.ja: Rosenbrock/小Bratuの大域化、重複gather/broadcast矩形写像、固定HVP、正枝陰関数則とliteral停止規約。

reference.batch58-67.f6b65d47060c.en: Fixed BFGS/L-BFGS m3 controls and declared strong-Wolfe/curvature rules; no universal global-convergence/scalability or exact n-step-termination guarantee.
reference.batch58-67.f6b65d47060c.ja: 固定BFGS/L-BFGS（3組）の制御例と明示したstrong-Wolfe・曲率規約だけを扱い、普遍的な大域収束・スケーラビリティ・厳密n段終了を保証しません。

reference.batch58-67.68ecfa8160a4.en: Finite-dimensional algebraic optimization and known minima
reference.batch58-67.68ecfa8160a4.ja: 有限次元代数最適化と既知最小点

reference.batch58-67.99db68fb427b.en: Dimensionless algebraic optimization of an eight-dimensional SPD quadratic and a two-variable Rosenbrock function. There is no physical spatial domain or PDE boundary; compare known minima and local iterative actions.
reference.batch58-67.99db68fb427b.ja: 8次元SPD二次関数と2変数Rosenbrockの無次元代数最適化です。物理空間・PDE境界を持たず、既知最小点と局所反復作用を比較します。

reference.batch58-67.5eee771af650.en: Known minima, gradients, Wolfe/curvature ledgers, and a dense reference using only the current last three pairs and current gamma0 I.
reference.batch58-67.5eee771af650.ja: 既知最小点、勾配、Wolfe/曲率ledger、現在保持する3組と現在γ0Iのdense作用参照。

reference.batch58-67.0035de0ce540.en: Shared foundations: differentiation, adjoints and inverse problems
reference.batch58-67.0035de0ce540.ja: 共通基盤：微分・随伴・逆問題

reference.batch58-67.82d20eee3334.en: Small fixed cases check differential actions and nonlinear/inverse iterations.
reference.batch58-67.82d20eee3334.ja: 小さな固定例で微分作用と非線形・逆問題の反復を確かめます。

reference.batch58-67.af51e977f3f9.en: Distinguish analytic, rational, high-precision and separate-implementation references; disclose shared libraries and unread originals.
reference.batch58-67.af51e977f3f9.ja: 手計算・有理数・高精度・別実装を役割別に照合し、共有ライブラリと未読原典を明記します。

reference.batch58-67.999bf54ad247.en: Grids, time steps, solver tolerances, coefficient counts, noise and regularization are distinct controlled comparisons.
reference.batch58-67.999bf54ad247.ja: 格子・時間・許容誤差・係数数・雑音・正則化をそれぞれ固定した比較です。

reference.batch58-67.1ad76e8b2125.en: No general large-scale performance, convergence, universal nonsmooth derivative or statistical coverage guarantee.
reference.batch58-67.1ad76e8b2125.ja: 大規模性能や一般的収束、非滑らかな点の普遍的な微分、雑音の被覆保証へは広げません。

reference.batch68-77.40a201fdef62.ja: Robertsonとvan der Pol、RK45の補間・イベント、非同次境界の分割法を小さな固定入力で検証します。独立参照、局所推定と実誤差、時間誤差と空間誤差を区別します。

reference.batch68-77.e7eda09c8ddf.en: Modal damping of steady multistage RK
reference.batch68-77.e7eda09c8ddf.ja: 定常多段RKのモード減衰

reference.batch68-77.f583b69b2522.en: A 16-component periodic linear field measures pseudo-time residual damping with stable, neutral and expanding controls. This is distinct from fourth-order accuracy for nonlinear physical-time problems.
reference.batch68-77.f583b69b2522.ja: 16成分の周期線形場で擬似時間の残差減衰を測り、安定・非減衰・発散の対照を示します。非線形非定常問題の4次精度とは区別します。

reference.batch68-77.8bdaf5bfc7a9.en: DAE initialization, conservation and constraint drift
reference.batch68-77.8bdaf5bfc7a9.ja: DAEの初期化・保存則・拘束ドリフト

reference.batch68-77.072f23a10bb4.en: Compare consistent initialization, an index-one conservation DAE, and an underlying ODE for an index-three pendulum. Comparisons with stored official IDA output are distinguished from newly executed independent ODE references.
reference.batch68-77.072f23a10bb4.ja: 整合初期化、index-1保存則DAE、index-3振り子の微分拘束に基づくODEを比較します。保存された公式IDA出力との比較と、新たに実行した独立ODE参照を区別します。

reference.batch68-77.f3a00819ddc4.en: Geometric integration of constraints, orbits and multiple frequencies
reference.batch68-77.f3a00819ddc4.ja: 拘束・軌道・多周波数の幾何積分

reference.batch68-77.0f05a21f3578.en: Fixed small examples compare SHAKE/RATTLE, Kepler orbits and coupled oscillators. Constraints, phase, energy and rounding effects are reported separately.
reference.batch68-77.0f05a21f3578.ja: SHAKE/RATTLE、Kepler軌道、結合振動子を固定した小規模条件で比較します。拘束、位相、エネルギーと丸め誤差を別々に示します。

reference.batch68-77.1410d0037d51.en: Robertson kinetics: initial stiffness and actual error
reference.batch68-77.1410d0037d51.ja: Robertson反応系の初期剛性と実誤差

reference.batch68-77.61dd0b09cf21.en: A nondimensional three-species system starts at (1, 0, 0) and ends at T = 0.4. The fixed methods use 512, 1024 and 2048 steps; two adaptive tolerance settings bring the total to eight runs.
reference.batch68-77.61dd0b09cf21.ja: 無次元3成分、初期値(1,0,0)、T=.4。固定512/1024/2048刻みと2許容誤差の適応法で計8run。

reference.batch68-77.3d3bb141eef5.en: Check actual errors at 22 common times, mass and minimum values at every accepted state, true stage residuals, and actual RHS, Jacobian, factorization and linear-solve counts separately. Conservation and positivity are observations for these inputs, not universal guarantees. Accuracy is sampled on T <= 0.4; this does not validate long-time chemistry or an all-time error bound.
reference.batch68-77.3d3bb141eef5.ja: 22共通時刻の実誤差、全受理時刻の質量/最小値、真の段階残差、実RHS/Jacobian/因子/solve数を別判定します。 保存/正値性は固定入力の観測で、一般的な保証ではありません。T=.4の短時間・標本時刻での精度であり、長時間化学精度や全時刻誤差上限は主張しません。

reference.batch68-77.876631deec37.en: Compare BDF2, SDIRK2 and adaptive step doubling on a short fixed interval against qualified Radau and BDF references.
reference.batch68-77.876631deec37.ja: 短い固定区間でBDF2・SDIRK2・倍分割適応法を、資格済みRadau/BDF参照と比較します。

reference.batch68-77.5ca0428479ac.en: BDF2 starts with backward Euler on the same grid. SDIRK2 stages use a weighted maximum residual and reuse Jacobian factors only within one stage. Adaptive steps use an RMS step-doubling estimate and accept the two-half-step result.
reference.batch68-77.5ca0428479ac.ja: BDF2は同格子BE開始。SDIRK2の非線形段階は重み付き最大残差で判定し、同じ段階内だけJacobian因子を再利用。適応法はRMS倍分割誤差と2半刻みを採用。

reference.batch68-77.06d08168e630.en: Check actual errors at 22 common times, mass and minimum values at every accepted state, true stage residuals, and actual RHS, Jacobian, factorization and linear-solve counts separately.
reference.batch68-77.06d08168e630.ja: 22共通時刻の実誤差、全受理時刻の質量/最小値、真の段階残差、実RHS/Jacobian/因子/solve数を別判定します。

reference.batch68-77.54f19a116003.en: Conservation and positivity are observations for these inputs, not universal guarantees. Accuracy is sampled on T <= 0.4; this does not validate long-time chemistry or an all-time error bound.

reference.batch68-77.470ab8d24a40.en: Ten fixed pendulum evolutions distinguish position constraints, full-time tangent momentum and interior centered momentum.
reference.batch68-77.470ab8d24a40.ja: 単振り子の10固定軌道で、位置拘束、全時刻の接線運動量と内部点の中心化運動量を区別します。

reference.batch68-77.1ab513b62349.en: Original scalar Newton position constraints, RATTLE final tangent impulses and SHAKE position pairs. SHAKE momentum is centered only at interior nodes; endpoint momenta are absent. SHAKE solves columns are eta, eta/h^2, position residual and Newton updates. Column1 uses the uniform recurrence normalization eta/h^2. For the first constrained half-step startup, the physical multiplier is 2*eta/h^2; later full position-Verlet steps use eta/h^2. Reverse-pair steps all use the later recurrence convention. RATTLE has its separate five-column normalization. No scientific gate or plot uses SHAKE column1.
reference.batch68-77.1ab513b62349.ja: 独自のスカラーNewton位置拘束、RATTLE終端接線impulse、SHAKE位置対。SHAKEの運動量は内部点だけで中心化し、端点を作りません。 SHAKEのsolves列はeta、eta/h^2、位置残差、Newton更新数です。列1は一律にeta/h^2ですが、初回半刻みの物理乗数は2eta/h^2、以後の位置Verletではeta/h^2です。逆位置対はすべて後者です。判定と図はこの列1を使いません。

reference.batch68-77.51e5d625ea8d.en: A separately qualified Jacobi family and angular DOP853 reference support 74 main decisions. Finite-C centered identities, two-delta reduced-map diagnostics and position-pair versus full-state reversals are distinct.
reference.batch68-77.51e5d625ea8d.ja: 独立Jacobi解析族と角度系DOP853の資格、74主判定。有限Cの中心化恒等式、2段階FDの縮約写像診断、位置対／全状態の逆積分を分離。

reference.batch68-77.ee81d892ceaf.en: Original SHAKE and RATTLE full texts remain unread; selected author lecture notes were inspected. The finite-difference symplectic defect is a local proxy, not a general proof, and centered SHAKE velocity is not assigned RATTLE tangency.
reference.batch68-77.ee81d892ceaf.ja: 原著SHAKE/RATTLE本文は未読で、著者講義ノートの選択箇所を確認。有限差分のsymplectic defectは一般証明ではなく、中心化SHAKE速度にRATTLEの接線拘束を要求しません。

reference.batch68-77.dd5def6dd3ae.en: Selected primary passages and separately qualified independent references. Actual outcomes are recorded in the saved result.json and verification.json.
reference.batch68-77.dd5def6dd3ae.ja: 一次資料の選択閲読と独立参照資格。実際の成否は保存result.jsonとverification.jsonに記録します。

reference.batch68-77.b2f5b5d0c0c8.en: Saved reduced phase portraits at h=0.01. SHAKE uses interior centered momentum; RATTLE uses full-time tangent momentum.
reference.batch68-77.b2f5b5d0c0c8.ja: 保存したh=0.01の縮約位相軌道。SHAKEは内部点の中心化運動量、RATTLEは全時刻の接線運動量です。

reference.batch68-77.1fdd4718a876.ja: 離心率を変えたKepler軌道と時間刻み

reference.batch68-77.27a88b129882.en: a=mu=reduced mass=1, without softening. One-period runs use 512/1024/2048 steps; ten-period controls use h0=2π/2048. Variable steps use h=h0|q| at the current state, with only the final step shortened to the physical endpoint.
reference.batch68-77.27a88b129882.ja: a=μ=換算質量=1、軟化なし。1周期は512/1024/2048刻み、10周期は基準2048刻み/周期。変動刻みh=h0|q|を現在状態から定め、最後だけ物理終端へ短縮。

reference.batch68-77.2bd803046ac0.en: An independent Kepler-equation family, qualified with brentq and bisection, supports 92 main decisions: full-state error, energy/angular momentum, at least eight periapses, finite-window order and reversal defects. Small invariant errors do not establish phase accuracy. No canonical symplectic-defect measurement is claimed for the variable-step map, and fixed-h properties are not transferred automatically. R1 resolution was revised to R2 using pre-execution asymptotic planning, not measured calibration.
reference.batch68-77.2bd803046ac0.ja: 独立のKepler方程式brentq／二分法解析族、92主判定。全状態誤差とエネルギー・角運動量、8回以上の近日点、有限窓の順序と反転誤差を検査。 保存量の小さい誤差から位相精度を推論しません。変動刻み写像の正準symplectic defectは測定せず、固定hの性質をそのまま移しません。初期解像度R1は数値実行前の漸近解析でR2へ改訂。

reference.batch68-77.22e8f95bbb0d.en: Sixteen fixed evolutions at e=0.1/0.7 compare invariants, same-time phase error, physical periapsis times and reversal.
reference.batch68-77.22e8f95bbb0d.ja: e=0.1/0.7の16固定軌道で、保存量と同時刻の位相誤差、実際の近日点時刻と逆積分を比較します。

reference.batch68-77.af4c5099b261.en: Original central-force KDK Verlet. Fixed, replayed and regenerated schedules are distinct. Positive radial crossings of cubic Hermite trajectories are localized by brentq.
reference.batch68-77.af4c5099b261.ja: 独自の中心力KDK Verlet。固定・保存刻み再生・再生成刻みを区別し、cubic Hermite軌道の正の放射速度交差をbrentqで局在化。

reference.batch68-77.eebde48ef245.en: An independent Kepler-equation family, qualified with brentq and bisection, supports 92 main decisions: full-state error, energy/angular momentum, at least eight periapses, finite-window order and reversal defects.
reference.batch68-77.eebde48ef245.ja: 独立のKepler方程式brentq／二分法解析族、92主判定。全状態誤差とエネルギー・角運動量、8回以上の近日点、有限窓の順序と反転誤差を検査。

reference.batch68-77.c6244f2b84a7.en: Small invariant errors do not establish phase accuracy. No canonical symplectic-defect measurement is claimed for the variable-step map, and fixed-h properties are not transferred automatically. R1 resolution was revised to R2 using pre-execution asymptotic planning, not measured calibration.
reference.batch68-77.c6244f2b84a7.ja: 保存量の小さい誤差から位相精度を推論しません。変動刻み写像の正準symplectic defectは測定せず、固定hの性質をそのまま移しません。初期解像度R1は数値実行前の漸近解析でR2へ改訂。

reference.batch68-77.632f45733a1f.en: Saved ten-period fixed-step and variable-step orbits at e=0.7, shown with equal physical aspect and an unsoftened central force.
reference.batch68-77.632f45733a1f.ja: 保存したe=0.7、10周期の固定刻み／変動刻み軌道。物理座標は等倍率で、中心力は軟化していません。

reference.batch68-77.f25e037ba79a.ja: 結合した2周波数系と共鳴の有限窓

reference.batch68-77.4a28af9bbd2b.en: alpha=1, omega=10/20, q0=(1,1/omega) and p0=0. Central probes retain the evaluated binary64 h and sin/cos coefficients without snapping to mathematical pi.
reference.batch68-77.4a28af9bbd2b.ja: α=1、ω=10/20、q0=(1,1/ω)、p0=0。中心probeは保存binary64のhとsin/cosをそのまま使い、πへ丸め直しません。

reference.batch68-77.6f40b524fda6.en: The 116 main decisions distinguish independent coupled normal modes, Decimal80/120 and Fraction frozen-coefficient maps, and stagewise gamma8 roundoff allowances. Ideal-pi Jordan structure is checked separately by rational identities. Each probe uses the current saved coefficient hex for its own Decimal80/120 actions; six accuracy actions use Decimal80. The central actual floating map remains unresolved; ideal-pi Jordan structure is not transferred to it. Results concern 64-step amplification and small fixed inputs, not a scanned resonance diagram, general stability or a universal long-time error theorem.
reference.batch68-77.6f40b524fda6.ja: 116主判定。独立の結合固有モード解析、保存係数Decimal80/120・Fraction写像、段階別γ8丸め上界を区別。理想πのJordan構造は有理恒等式で別確認。 各probeは現在保存した係数hexからDecimal80/120を評価し、6精度軌道はDecimal80を用います。 中心の実浮動係数写像はunresolvedとし、理想πのJordan性を移しません。64刻み増幅と小さい固定入力の観測であり、走査した共鳴図・一般安定性・長時間の普遍誤差定理は主張しません。

reference.batch68-77.2e860abe1820.en: A genuinely coupled two-degree-of-freedom system uses twelve 64-step probes and six accuracy trajectories to separate normal modes, coordinate exchange, discrete maps and roundoff.
reference.batch68-77.2e860abe1820.ja: 2自由度の実結合系で、12の64刻みprobeと6の精度軌道を使い、真のモード、座標間交換、離散写像と丸めを分けます。

reference.batch68-77.c6da0ea8ab25.en: Full-potential Verlet and a Strang impulse composition: half B kick, exact A flow, half B kick. A contains the fast oscillator and slow free drift; B contains the slow potential and the coupling.
reference.batch68-77.c6da0ea8ab25.ja: 全ポテンシャルVerletと、B半kick・A厳密flow・B半kickのStrang impulse。Aには高速調和振動子と低速自由流、Bには低速位置項と結合を含めます。

reference.batch68-77.ccfbe8965c88.en: The 116 main decisions distinguish independent coupled normal modes, Decimal80/120 and Fraction frozen-coefficient maps, and stagewise gamma8 roundoff allowances. Ideal-pi Jordan structure is checked separately by rational identities. Each probe uses the current saved coefficient hex for its own Decimal80/120 actions; six accuracy actions use Decimal80.
reference.batch68-77.ccfbe8965c88.ja: 116主判定。独立の結合固有モード解析、保存係数Decimal80/120・Fraction写像、段階別γ8丸め上界を区別。理想πのJordan構造は有理恒等式で別確認。 各probeは現在保存した係数hexからDecimal80/120を評価し、6精度軌道はDecimal80を用います。

reference.batch68-77.4ec9b0b06ec5.en: The central actual floating map remains unresolved; ideal-pi Jordan structure is not transferred to it. Results concern 64-step amplification and small fixed inputs, not a scanned resonance diagram, general stability or a universal long-time error theorem.
reference.batch68-77.4ec9b0b06ec5.ja: 中心の実浮動係数写像はunresolvedとし、理想πのJordan性を移しません。64刻み増幅と小さい固定入力の観測であり、走査した共鳴図・一般安定性・長時間の普遍誤差定理は主張しません。

reference.batch68-77.f46964684c00.en: Saved q1–q2 coordinates of the finest impulse trajectory, colored by physical time. This is one coupled trajectory, not a scanned phase diagram.
reference.batch68-77.f46964684c00.ja: 保存した最細impulse軌道の実q1–q2座標と物理時刻。これは走査相図ではなく、結合した1軌道です。

reference.batch68-77.2314bac42502.en: Explicit time integration combines an embedded 5(4) error estimator, adaptive steps, a quartic continuous extension and directed events.
reference.batch68-77.2314bac42502.ja: 埋込み5(4)誤差推定と刻み制御、4次の連続拡張、向き付きイベントを組み合わせる陽的時間積分です。

reference.batch68-77.2c55920e53bb.en: No general guarantee is provided for stiff systems, tangential roots, multiple crossings per step or reset systems. Local tolerances are not global error bounds.
reference.batch68-77.2c55920e53bb.ja: 硬い系、接触根、1刻み内の複数交差、reset系の一般保証はありません。局所許容誤差を大域誤差の上界とみなしません。

reference.batch68-77.83ae7f7622da.en: The target is a smooth nonstiff initial-value problem; tolerances must match component scales.
reference.batch68-77.83ae7f7622da.ja: 滑らかな非硬い初期値問題を対象とし、許容誤差は成分の尺度に合わせます。

reference.batch68-77.27df1719fdd7.en: FSAL reuses the RHS owned by the accepted state and never promotes a rejected trial endpoint.
reference.batch68-77.27df1719fdd7.ja: FSALは受理状態の右辺を再利用し、棄却した試行の端点で置き換えません。

reference.batch68-77.8a4f6643965b.en: Simple sign crossings are localized on interpolants of retained accepted steps.
reference.batch68-77.8a4f6643965b.ja: 保存した受理区間の補間を用いて単純な符号交差を探します。

reference.batch68-77.db0c577b0ef3.en: Time and step size share units; atol has each state component's units and rtol is dimensionless.
reference.batch68-77.db0c577b0ef3.ja: 時刻と刻みは同じ単位です。atolは各成分、rtolは無次元の尺度です。

reference.batch68-77.340a0d572d5e.en: The ODE step has no spatial boundary; an RHS for a semidiscrete PDE must supply its boundaries.
reference.batch68-77.340a0d572d5e.ja: ODE自体に空間境界はなく、空間離散した系では右辺が境界を供給します。

reference.batch68-77.1698670faa1b.en: The separately versioned supplement is the executable evidence for the fixed examples; chapter links are additional context.
reference.batch68-77.1698670faa1b.ja: 実行の根拠は版を固定した追加配布例です。章へのリンクは補足解説です。

reference.batch68-77.ef392cf71439.en: A multistage iteration forms each stage from a fixed base state and advances pseudo-time to damp steady residuals.
reference.batch68-77.ef392cf71439.ja: 基準状態から各段階を構成する多段反復で、擬似時間を進めて定常残差を減衰させます。

reference.batch68-77.658303eca94e.en: The chosen stability polynomial matches classical RK4 on linear problems, but this is not a fourth-order method for general nonlinear problems. Stable modes, a neutral control and an expanding control are distinguished.
reference.batch68-77.658303eca94e.ja: 採用多項式は線形問題では古典RK4と一致しますが、一般非線形問題の4次法ではありません。安定なモード、非減衰対照、発散対照を区別します。

reference.batch68-77.b6abd5f16ca2.en: The selected coefficients are 1/4, 1/3, 1/2 and 1; all stages share the same base state.
reference.batch68-77.b6abd5f16ca2.ja: 採用係数は1/4,1/3,1/2,1で、各段階の基準値は同じです。

reference.batch68-77.567b94f24e8d.en: Residuals, modal amplitudes and phase are measured on a fixed 16-component periodic linear system.
reference.batch68-77.567b94f24e8d.ja: 固定した16成分の周期線形系で残差・モード振幅・位相を測ります。

reference.batch68-77.5270f247adf7.en: The product of pseudo-time step and operator eigenvalue is dimensionless; physical-time accuracy is a separate question.
reference.batch68-77.5270f247adf7.ja: 擬似時間刻みと作用素固有値の積は無次元です。物理時間精度の主張とは分けます。

reference.batch68-77.48ae06c2ac04.en: The fixed example applies periodic differences at every stage.
reference.batch68-77.48ae06c2ac04.ja: 固定例は周期格子で、周期差分を全段階に適用します。

reference.batch68-77.c3dc99555079.en: A Verlet-type discrete map solves position constraints. The pendulum example selects the nearby continuous branch and distinguishes momentum reconstructed by centered differences.
reference.batch68-77.c3dc99555079.ja: 位置拘束を解くVerlet型の離散写像です。振り子では連続な近傍枝を固定し、中心差分で再構成した運動量を区別します。

reference.batch68-77.bc6c38fa52d5.en: The tangency residual of reconstructed centered momentum is distinct from the RATTLE velocity constraint. Only fixed examples with one smooth circular constraint are validated; general constraint networks are outside this release.
reference.batch68-77.bc6c38fa52d5.ja: 中心差分運動量の接線残差をRATTLEの速度拘束と同一視しません。単一の滑らかな円拘束の固定例であり、一般の拘束ネットワークは未検証です。

reference.batch68-77.2c8510bf1bba.en: The planar pendulum has unit mass, length and gravity, initial angle 0.7 and zero initial angular velocity.
reference.batch68-77.2c8510bf1bba.ja: 単位質量・長さ・重力の平面振り子で、初期角は0.7、初期角速度は0です。

reference.batch68-77.6dd164cff04a.en: The position-constraint solve uses fixed iteration and residual limits; nonconvergence is retained as failure.
reference.batch68-77.6dd164cff04a.ja: 位置拘束の非線形解法は反復上限と残差基準を固定し、未収束を成功に置き換えません。

reference.batch68-77.a43b26983733.en: The fixed example is nondimensional; constraint and multiplier units depend on the formulation in general.
reference.batch68-77.a43b26983733.ja: 固定例は無次元です。一般には拘束と乗数の単位は定式化に依存します。

reference.batch68-77.260d51b2aa05.en: There is no spatial boundary; conditions are the position and velocity constraint manifolds.
reference.batch68-77.260d51b2aa05.ja: 空間境界はなく、位置と速度の拘束面が条件です。

reference.batch68-77.2e3f49c63076.en: A Verlet-type discrete map enforces position and velocity constraints. Newton residuals, time reversal and time-discretization error are measured separately.
reference.batch68-77.2e3f49c63076.ja: 位置と速度の拘束をVerlet型の段階で満たす離散写像です。Newton残差、時間反転、時間離散誤差を分けて測ります。

reference.batch68-77.dcf3341b802f.en: Geometric structure concerns the map on the constraint manifold. This does not imply exact energy conservation or a guarantee for arbitrary constraints and solver tolerances. Numerical Jacobians provide a limited diagnostic.
reference.batch68-77.dcf3341b802f.ja: 構造保存は拘束面上の写像についての性質です。エネルギーの厳密保存や任意の拘束・許容誤差での一般保証を意味しません。数値Jacobianは限定した診断です。

reference.batch68-77.6d0b9a90b66e.en: Distinguish the stiff three-species ODE from an index-one DAE obtained by replacing one equation with conservation.
reference.batch68-77.6d0b9a90b66e.ja: 3成分の硬い反応ODEと、保存則を代数式に置き換えたindex-1 DAEを区別して比較します。

reference.batch68-77.0132eab38c26.en: Fixed educational models; see each release for inputs, reference qualification and limits.
reference.batch68-77.0132eab38c26.ja: 固定した教育用モデルです。各配布版の入力、参照の検証、制限を確認してください。

reference.batch68-77.12e3f2801a4c.en: Compare work and error for fixed mu values over a short interval; this does not validate a full relaxation cycle.
reference.batch68-77.12e3f2801a4c.ja: 固定したμと短い時区間で硬さによる仕事量と誤差を比較します。完全な緩和振動周期の検証ではありません。

reference.batch68-77.642f209ce23a.ja: 有限次元の線形発展系

reference.batch68-77.ffd8fad4fab0.en: Each example distinguishes physical time in damped rotation from pseudo-time used to reduce steady residuals.
reference.batch68-77.ffd8fad4fab0.ja: 減衰回転の物理時刻と、定常残差を減衰させる擬似時間を例ごとに区別します。

reference.batch68-77.793ac097f0a5.ja: 非同次境界を持つ線形反応拡散

reference.batch68-77.77d0f24fd395.en: Separate temporal errors relative to the same nonperiodic finite-difference system from spatial errors relative to the continuous exact family.
reference.batch68-77.77d0f24fd395.ja: 同じ非周期有限差分系に対する時間誤差と、連続厳密解に対する空間誤差を分けます。

reference.batch68-77.b17a2e95aac5.en: Small fixed examples expose consistent initialization and separate differential/algebraic residuals; this is not a general-purpose DAE solver.
reference.batch68-77.b17a2e95aac5.ja: 整合初期化と微分・代数残差を扱う小規模な固定例です。一般DAEソルバーの完成を意味しません。

reference.batch68-77.6f4bbfb61af8.en: Distinguish the original position-constrained DAE, an underlying ODE based on differentiated constraints, and the SHAKE/RATTLE discrete maps.
reference.batch68-77.6f4bbfb61af8.ja: 元の位置拘束DAE、微分した拘束に基づくODE、SHAKE/RATTLEの離散写像を区別します。

reference.batch68-77.a99fbccd2c46.en: Nondimensional planar ellipses separate phase, angular momentum, energy and step-selection effects.
reference.batch68-77.a99fbccd2c46.ja: 無次元化した平面楕円軌道で位相、角運動量、エネルギーと刻みの影響を分けます。

reference.batch68-77.8c0e7308ef1e.ja: 二周波数の結合調和振動子

reference.batch68-77.963934537135.en: Separate continuous normal modes, the ideal split map, a map with stored floating-point coefficients, and repeated rounded updates.
reference.batch68-77.963934537135.ja: 連続正規モード、理想分割写像、保存した浮動小数点係数の写像、実際の反復丸めを区別します。

reference.batch68-77.fcc93e0a4870.en: Small fixed examples compare backward Euler and Newton for index-one DAEs, consistent initialization, conservation and constraint drift.
reference.batch68-77.fcc93e0a4870.ja: 小規模な固定例で、index-1 DAEの後退Euler・Newton法、整合初期化、保存則と拘束ドリフトを比較します。

reference.batch68-77.81bcf3534a55.en: Scope is limited to small fixed systems and inputs. The coarse Robertson schedule does not meet the original temporal accuracy/refinement goals; those false decisions are retained and shown. Underlying ODEs based on differentiated constraints can drift from the original constraint. General index handling, large sparse DAEs and convergence for arbitrary inputs are unverified.
reference.batch68-77.81bcf3534a55.ja: 固定した小規模系と入力に限ります。Robertsonの粗い刻みは当初の時間精度・収束目標を達成しておらず、元のFALSE判定を保存して表示します。微分した拘束を使うODEでは元の拘束がドリフトし得ます。一般のindex処理・大規模疎DAE・任意入力の収束は未検証です。

reference.batch68-77.24fd1e0fe7da.en: Other models and larger systems require separately frozen inputs, references and criteria.
reference.batch68-77.24fd1e0fe7da.ja: 別のモデルや大規模化は、入力・参照・基準を改めて固定して検証します。

reference.batch68-77.c62eb9f6ece5.en: For the index-one examples, the algebraic constraint Jacobian must be nonsingular on the selected branch and Newton iterations must satisfy fixed criteria.

reference.batch78-87.33d9d600dd70.en: Compare with exact rational second-derivative systems, rational PCHIP and SciPy 1.14.1. Fifteen endpoint records contain sixteen scalar outputs from thirteen distinct inputs. Independent Fraction formulas show plateau undershoot for the actual binary64 data. PCHIP is generally C1, not necessarily C2. Best approximation, extrapolation and noise smoothing are outside scope. A SciPy comparison does not substitute for reading the original papers.
reference.batch78-87.33d9d600dd70.ja: 正確な有理2階微分系・有理PCHIP・SciPy 1.14.1を照合。端点15記録は16スカラー出力・13異なる入力。平坦部の負値は実binary64をFraction化した独立式で示します。 PCHIPは通常C1でありC2とは限りません。一般データの最良近似・外挿・ノイズ平滑化は対象外。SciPyは原著完全閲読の代用ではありません。

reference.batch78-87.6665e98cc8aa.ja: 12解析・36再構成。独立行列・Fraction/Decimal係数、完全再構成、二乗L2誤差を照合。長さ32のみ直交誤差恒等式を要求し、17点では追加エネルギーを段別保存します。 Haarに限定し長いフィルタや画像圧縮は対象外。一般の対称拡張に正規直交性を仮定しません。シフト不変性は要求せず、シフト別差を保存します。

reference.batch78-87.1c2495f36de9.en: Apply three-level Haar analysis to short signals of lengths 17 and 32, separating one-sample shifts from odd-length boundary handling.

reference.batch78-87.e68bfeb3ccea.en: Implement pair-sum and pair-difference filters, downsampling and inverse pyramids. Reconstruct with no threshold, hard thresholding and soft thresholding from the same analysis coefficients.
reference.batch78-87.e68bfeb3ccea.ja: 和差フィルタ・間引き・逆ピラミッドを自作。閾値なし・hard・softの3条件を同じ解析係数から再構成します。

reference.batch78-87.9c14eac4c83c.en: Use twelve analyses and thirty-six reconstructions. Check independent matrices, Fraction/Decimal coefficients, perfect reconstruction and squared L2 errors. Require the orthogonal error identity only at length 32; retain level-by-level padding energy at length 17.
reference.batch78-87.9c14eac4c83c.ja: 12解析・36再構成。独立行列・Fraction/Decimal係数、完全再構成、二乗L2誤差を照合。長さ32のみ直交誤差恒等式を要求し、17点では追加エネルギーを段別保存します。

This comparison concerns a fixed tiny discrete operator, without arbitrary-resolution, distributional or OOD guarantees. reference.batch78-87.9d838b4f90a8.en: Compare with independent full-system Radau/BDF references and an implicit scalar identity for the reduced equation. Check E+C=E₀, S+C+P=1, positivity and actual acceptance, rejection and Newton work. Retain both all-time errors including the initial layer and errors on the declared θ≥0.02 window. These two small-ε fixed-rate examples are educational. ε is a scale ratio, not itself a certified QSSA error bound. The θ≥0.02 window is not a proof that the initial layer has ended, and the calculation is not an in-vivo prediction.

reference.final23.f5c5dbf03979.ja: D=r=1、T=1、特殊速度5/√6を固定。L=12で空間・時間系列を調べ、L=6/12/24で定数端点の境界系列を比較します。無次元で拡散係数と反応率は1。厳密前線の境界値と定数境界を区別し、有限領域の影響を残します。

reference.final23.e77cf3e4d952.en: On[0,2π]² toT2,use a.1,b.9,Du.01,Dv1. Compare three perturbations of(1,.9),12/24/48cell grids and fixed nonperiodic boundary conditions. Dimensionless square [0,2pi]², diffusion coefficients 0.01 and 1. Single/mixed Neumann modes and a single mode with equilibrium Dirichlet data.
reference.final23.e77cf3e4d952.ja: [0,2π]²、T=2、a=0.1、b=0.9、Du=0.01、Dv=1。(1,0.9)からの3摂動、12/24/48セルと固定非周期境界を比較します。Neumannの単一・混合モードと、平衡Dirichlet境界の単一モードを区別します。

reference.final23.6798d2b08752.en: On the unit square toT.25,manufacture forcing for n=1+.1e⁻ᵗcosπx cosπy,c=1+.05e⁻²ᵗcosπx cos2πy with divergence-free tangential advection. Dimensionless; manufactured-field coefficients and forcing are fixed in inputs.json. Manufactured forcing and boundary fluxes, with explicit ownership of interior faces and corners.
reference.final23.6798d2b08752.ja: 単位正方形でT=0.25まで、n=1+0.1e⁻ᵗcos(πx)cos(πy)、c=1+0.05e⁻²ᵗcos(πx)cos(2πy)に対応する外力を製造し、発散零で境界に接する移流を用います。無次元の係数と外力をinputs.jsonに固定。内面・角の所有を明示して製造外力と境界流束を扱います。

reference.final23.cfb85788d857.ja: NH・chain・弱結合・速度固定の比較

reference.final23.7ef160ed01f4.en: Fix unit masses,kBT1,frequencies1/1.7 and quartic0/.2. Compare NH1,NHC3,Berendsen and fixed-speed baths at two couplings/two steps with256canonical and128heated replicas. Dimensionless, unit masses, kBT=1, frequencies 1/1.7; Q1=2tau², Qj=tau². Two-mode initial-value problem without spatial boundaries; fixed canonical/heated ensembles.
reference.final23.7ef160ed01f4.ja: 質量1、kBT=1、振動数1/1.7、四次係数0/0.2。NH1・NHC3・Berendsen・固定速さの熱浴を、2結合・2刻み、正準256/加熱128標本で比較します。無次元でQ1=2τ²、Qj=τ²。空間境界のない2モード初期値問題で、正準・加熱アンサンブルを固定します。

reference.final23.0cbb94fa4da0.ja: 拘束・重心除去と正準統計

reference.final23.c5e974f9e765.en: Use three1Dparticles of masses1/2/3 in one common harmonic potential. No constraints,COM,COM-relative and a redundant-row equivalent have f3/2/1/1,each with1,024replicas. Dimensionless; masses 1/2/3 and kBT=1. Fixed linear constraints Cq=0 and CM⁻¹p=0; redundant rows are compared on the same tangent space.
reference.final23.c5e974f9e765.ja: 共通の調和ポテンシャル中の1次元3粒子で質量1/2/3、kBT=1。無拘束・COM・COM相対・冗長行の等価拘束で有効自由度3/2/1/1、各1,024標本を比較します。固定線形拘束Cq=0、CM⁻¹p=0を用い、冗長行は同じ接空間上で比較します。

reference.final23.2134073e816a.en: Saltzman-type skew-grid piston: 2D Euler and ALE
reference.final23.2134073e816a.ja: Saltzman型の歪み格子ピストン：2次元EulerとALE

reference.final23.b9bb454f29cf.en: Tan–Lv–Zhu (2023) Example 8 variant with e0=1e-4 and finite initial pressure. Prescribed affine ALE, 2D Euler and Rusanov; not their material Lagrangian mesh, WENO/remap scheme or a full reproduction of the unread 1985 report.
reference.final23.b9bb454f29cf.ja: Tan–Lv–Zhu（2023）Example 8に対応するe0=10⁻⁴・有限初期圧力の変種です。規定したアフィンALE、2次元Euler、Rusanovを用います。同論文の物質Lagrange格子・WENO/remap法や、未読の1985年原報全体の再現ではありません。

reference.final23.1a25e676f3d7.en: Williamson-type spherical rotation: tilted axes and pole crossing
reference.final23.1a25e676f3d7.ja: Williamson型の球面固体回転輸送：傾いた軸と極通過

reference.final23.e2159bf06b2e.en: Only prescribed scalar solid-body rotation on a unit sphere. Original W92 equations remain unread; selected Nair author formulas cross-check conventions. Both grids use eleven noncommensurate remaps. Bilinear interpolation is nonconservative; report mass drift and do not claim temporal convergence or a nonlinear global SWE core.
reference.final23.e2159bf06b2e.ja: 単位球上の規定スカラー剛体回転に限定します。W92原著の式は未読で、Nair著者資料の選択式から規約を照合。両格子で整合しない位相の11回再配置を用います。双線形補間は非保存なので質量変動を報告し、時間収束や非線形の全球浅水コアは主張しません。

reference.final23.b9bcd82dc5bd.en: Time evolution of axisymmetric spherical shallow-water balance
reference.final23.b9bcd82dc5bd.ja: 球面浅水波の軸対称定常釣合いを時間積分

reference.final23.6e9586a46f7a.en: Axisymmetric nondimensional subproblem with a=g=1, Omega=2, u0=.5 and h0=10. Actual time evolution uses centered primitive momentum, finite-volume mass and RK4. Not standard Earth parameters, a full global multidimensional SWE core, exact discrete balance or a PV-conservation claim.
reference.final23.6e9586a46f7a.ja: a=g=1、Ω=2、u0=0.5、h0=10の無次元軸対称部分問題です。中心差分のprimitive運動量、有限体積の質量、RK4で実際に時間発展させます。標準地球パラメータ、多次元の全球浅水コア、離散厳密釣合い、渦位保存の主張は含みません。

reference.final23.1948fa7020d4.en: Sod-type particle shock tube with Gaussian-convolution GSPH
reference.final23.1948fa7020d4.ja: Gaussian畳込みGSPHによるSod型粒子衝撃管

reference.final23.2268b39805f1.en: Actual Gaussian linear-specific-volume GSPH overlap with symmetric variable h, independent pair Riemann solves and antisymmetric total-energy exchange; not substitution of star pressure into ordinary SPH. First-order reconstruction only, not the paper cubic/MUSCL implementation or a general accuracy claim.
reference.final23.2268b39805f1.ja: Gaussianの線形比体積GSPH重なり積分、対称な可変h、独立な対Riemann解、反対称な全エネルギー交換を実装します。通常SPHへの星状態圧力の代入とは区別。再構築は1次に限定し、原著の3次/MUSCL実装や一般的な高精度は主張しません。

reference.final23.c061ce6d0bc6.en: Uniform pressure and acoustics: particle-layout effects in SPH/GSPH
reference.final23.c061ce6d0bc6.ja: 一様圧力と線形音波：SPH/GSPHの粒子配置依存

reference.final23.caeaef885cfe.en: GSPH with 128 jittered particles at t=0.2. The initial kernel reconstruction error reaches 0.011834, exceeding the acoustic amplitude 0.001 and remaining visible in the left density profile; the right panel shows that initial error. Acceptance concerns the fundamental Fourier mode phase/amplitude and other fixed conservation controls, not pointwise high accuracy or general superiority.
reference.final23.caeaef885cfe.ja: t=0.2、位置を揺らした128粒子のGSPHです。初期kernel再構成誤差は0.011834に達し、音波振幅0.001を上回って左の密度波形に残ります。右図はその初期誤差です。合格条件は基本Fourierモードの位相・振幅と固定した保存検査であり、各点の高精度や一般的な優位性ではありません。
